Confused singer can still start new song randomly.
Effects and passives will be overwritten by new songs from other characters, but previous singer will still be unable to act until remaining duration ends.

skills.desc:
State of strengthening and inspiring all party members with the power of singing.
* Activates status Singing on user: inability to act and applies effects from song skills on all party members.
* Does not replace active Zones or Prayers and vice versa, can be active at the same time.
* Is not considered a Zone for Zone-related skill effects.
* Confused singer can still start new song randomly.
* Effects and passives will be overwritten by new songs from other characters, but previous singer will still be unable to act until remaining duration ends.
* User can act in Stellar Burst if they fulfill requirements, however user will revert to their Singing state afterwards. If user use another Song based skill, the new skill will override the Singing state

skills.desc:
Awakens any Elemental Type Zones or a Damage Type Attack Zones or some Hybrid Zones:
* Applicable Hybrid Zones are Double Strike Stance Attack Zones, & Moonlight Stance
* Doubles damage multiplicators for Zones:
** to +60% for Attack Zones and Thunder, Crystal, Shade (other elements) Type Zones
** to +100% for Fire, Water, Wind, Earth and Shade Type Zones
** Doubles "damage on weakness/resist" effects for Crystal/Shade Type Zone respectively
* Zone cannot be overwritten by other zones during the duration and duration cannot be extended by attempting to reactivate Another Zone
* Zone can still be removed/broken by skills that remove zones
* After duration ends, zone is removed
* Support Effects can be used at the same time as Another Zone
* Via active skills, can be activated only once per character
** When there is no appropriate zone or the zone is already awakened, using a skill that can awaken Zone will not consume awakening ability
** Non-active skill sources may activate it more than once per battle if explicitly stated

skills.desc:
User has a chance equal to their physical critical rate to reduce own damage taken by a % determined by their LCK
* Damage Reduction: (LCK ÷ 500) × 75%, maximum 75% (500 LCK)
** Multiplicative with all other types of damage modification
** Applies against physical, magic, and fixed damage attacks (including self-damage)
** Applies against enemy end-of-turn attacks
* Mid-battle changes to critical rate and LCK are also used
